name: Zscaler

eyebrow.en: Zscaler, Inc. · Common stock · San Jose, California
eyebrow.zh: Zscaler · 普通股 · 加州圣何塞

title.en: Zero trust security, now selling to AI.
title.zh: 零信任安全，开始卖给 AI。

lede.en: Zscaler sells cloud security that sits between users and apps. Revenue grew 25% to $898M last quarter (20% without the Red Canary acquisition), organic net new ARR accelerated to 17%, and AI security bookings jumped 50%. Free cash flow margin slipped to 23% as it built more data center capacity.
lede.zh: Zscaler 提供介于用户与应用之间的云安全服务。上季营收增 25% 至 8.98 亿美元（不含收购的 Red Canary 为 20%），有机新增 ARR 增速加快至 17%，AI 安全订单大增 50%。因扩建数据中心，自由现金流利润率降至 23%。

s.en: Q1 FY27 · date not yet announced
s.zh: FY27 第一季 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock ranged from about $115 to $337 over the past year.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。过去一年股价在约 $115 至 $337 间。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Zscaler's fiscal year ends July 31. GAAP operating margin is still slightly negative because of stock compensation; non-GAAP operating margin was a record 24%. The last bar is guidance at the midpoint.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。Zscaler 财年截至7月31日。因股权激励，GAAP 营业利润率仍略为负；非GAAP营业利润率创纪录达 24%。最后一根柱为指引中值。

s.zh: +25% · 不含 Red Canary 为 36.3 亿

s.en: organic growth 17%, up from 7% in FY25

p.en: Bookings for Security for AI and agentic security products rose about 50%, and organic net new ARR growth accelerated to 17%.
p.zh: AI 安全与智能体安全产品订单增约 50%，有机新增 ARR 增速加快至 17%。

p.en: FY27 ARR is guided to grow 16.6–17.4%, below the 25% just reported, partly because of a sales leadership transition.
p.zh: FY27 ARR 指引增长 16.6–17.4%，低于刚公布的 25%，部分因销售领导层交接。

p.en: Capex and capitalized software were $218.5M in Q4, up from $78.7M, cutting quarterly free cash flow to $60.8M.
p.zh: 第四季资本开支与资本化软件达 2.185 亿美元（去年 7870 万），季度自由现金流降至 6080 万。

p.en: About 48× next year's non-GAAP earnings; the stock moved 8% in a day on Oct 9.
p.zh: 约为明年非GAAP盈利的 48 倍；10月9日单日波动 8%。

sources: Q4 FY26 call: AI bookings, guidance
Price, market cap and beta: Financial Modeling Prep, as of Oct 9, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Zscaler, Inc..
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Zscaler, Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q1 FY22 to Q4 FY26. Zscaler's fiscal year ends July 31. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 FY22 第一季至 FY26 第四季共 20 个季度。Zscaler 财年截至7月31日。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Zscaler has generated cash in every one of the last 20 quarters, with a seasonal spike in the October quarter when annual bills are collected. FY26 free cash flow was $779M on the company's measure, but Q4 fell to $61M as capex tripled.
read.zh: 过去 20 个季度 Zscaler 每季都有正现金流，10月季度因收取年费而季节性走高。按公司口径 FY26 自由现金流 7.79 亿美元，但第四季因资本开支增至三倍降至 6100 万。

read.en: Guidance points to a 23–23.5% free cash flow margin on about $3.92B of revenue in FY27, roughly $900–950M. I spread that with the usual pattern: a big October quarter and a capex-heavy July quarter.
read.zh: 指引显示 FY27 营收约 39.2 亿美元、自由现金流率 23–23.5%，约 9–9.5 亿美元。我按惯常季节性分配：10月季度最高，7月季度资本开支最重。

p.en: $218.5M of capex and capitalized software in Q4 alone, up from $78.7M.
p.zh: 仅第四季资本开支与资本化软件就达 2.185 亿美元（去年 7870 万）。

p.en: $918M was spent on acquisitions in FY26, mainly Red Canary.
p.zh: FY26 收购支出 9.18 亿美元，主要为 Red Canary。

p.en: Customers prepay annual subscriptions; deferred revenue rose 19% to $2.93B.
p.zh: 客户预付年度订阅；递延收入增 19% 至 29.3 亿美元。

p.en: ARR is guided to $4.40–4.43B by the end of FY27.
p.zh: FY27 年底 ARR 指引为 44.0–44.3 亿美元。

bridgeNote.en: Excludes acquisitions and convertible note settlements.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入收购及可转债结算。

extraNote.en: Zscaler's own free cash flow also deducts capitalized internal-use software, so it runs slightly lower (Q4 FY26: $60.8M vs $79.5M here).
extraNote.zh: Zscaler 自身口径还扣除资本化内部软件，因此略低（FY26 Q4：公司 6080 万，本表 7950 万）。
